tokens.name: mauveine
tokens.usage: Main · 28% of a light-mode screen surface (4% in Hacker mode). Carries the brand: hero blocks, headers, links, the 6 px bar. Paper type on top (8.76:1). Never as text or lines on Ink or Logwood (2.40:1).

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: Main · 8% light, 10% Hacker mode. Blocks and rules, in print too. Paper type on top (14.20:1).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Neutral · 31% light, 8% Hacker mode. The ground: Paper leads every light-mode layout. Type colour on Mauveine, Logwood 800, Indigo and Logwood. Headings on Ink. Printed documents are set on Paper, never a tinted stock. On every dark colour, text is white: never an off-white or ghost-white tint.

tokens.name: logwood
tokens.usage: Neutral · 7% light, 20% Hacker mode. Logwood 950. Long-form body below Ink headings on Paper (15.96:1); cards and panels on Ink, always with a logwood-700 edge (Logwood against Ink alone is 1.32:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Neutral · 5% light, 41% Hacker mode. Type on Paper (21.00:1), on Weld (14.54:1) and on Madder (7.89:1). The Hacker-mode canvas.

tokens.name: madder
tokens.usage: Accent · 5% light, 7% Hacker mode. Alerts. Ink type only (7.89:1); Paper on Madder fails (2.66:1). Madder on Paper is 2.66:1, below the 3:1 floor: chart series and icons in Madder take an Ink outline, or move to madder-800. On Ink: errors and warnings at 7.89:1 (6.00:1 on Logwood), always with the Alert icon and the word in capitals.

tokens.name: weld
tokens.usage: Accent · 6% light, 4% Hacker mode. Highlights and rewards; in Hacker mode prompt, cursor, selection. Ink type on Weld fills (14.54:1). Weld on Paper is 1.44:1: Weld buttons and chips on Paper take a 1.5 px Ink border or an Ink label. Weld text allowed on Ink only (14.54:1). Keep near 6%; past that, the palette turns loud.

tokens.name: logwood-800
tokens.usage: Support · 10% light, 6% Hacker mode. Section labels, captions, notes and structural headers, on screen and in print (8.49:1 on Paper). Paper type on Logwood 800 fills (8.49:1).

tokens.name: madder-800
tokens.usage: Alert text on Paper (7.59:1), on screen and in print, and the 2 px border of an invalid field. Madder as graphics on Paper moves here.

tokens.name: mauveine-300
tokens.usage: The 6 px bar and progress fill in Hacker mode (7.84:1 on Ink). Not for text or links: links on dark use Mauveine 200.

tokens.name: mauveine-200
tokens.usage: Indicators on Logwood (9.48:1), with a dot or underline.

tokens.name: logwood-50
tokens.usage: Fill only, never text: quiet panels and table zebra rows (surface-raised in light mode).

tokens.name: logwood-100
tokens.usage: Fill only, never text: skeleton blocks, avatar circles, disabled fills.

tokens.name: logwood-200
tokens.usage: Brand ramp value, kept exact. In light mode a 1 px rule only (card edges, table rules), never text. In Hacker mode it is the muted text colour through text-muted: 15.35:1 and 11.67:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: logwood-300
tokens.usage: Ramp step. Fill only, never text.

tokens.name: logwood-400
tokens.usage: Borders and dividers in Hacker mode, 6.63:1 on surface-raised there. Never text in light mode.

tokens.name: logwood-500
tokens.usage: Ramp step. Fill only, never text.

tokens.name: logwood-600
tokens.usage: Icons and large text (24 px and up) in light mode only: 4.39:1 on the light surface. Disabled labels.

tokens.name: logwood-700
tokens.usage: Rules, graphics and small text in light mode (6.09:1 on the light surface); input borders. In Hacker mode: card edges and hairlines (3.45:1).

tokens.name: logwood-900
tokens.usage: Ramp step: 10.42:1 on the light surface.

tokens.name: logwood-950
tokens.usage: Logwood itself, the end of the ramp: 15.96:1 on the light surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. Light: Paper. Hacker mode: Ink is the canvas.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Quiet panels (light). Cards and panels on Ink (Hacker mode), always with a hairline edge.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text. Grounds: surface and surface-raised. Light 21.00:1 and 19.6:1. Hacker mode: white, 21.00:1 and 15.96:1. Never off-white or ghost white on a dark colour.

tokens.name: text-heading
tokens.usage: Headings. Grounds: surface and surface-raised. 21.00:1 in both themes (Ink on light, white on dark).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, notes, labels, tags, metadata. Grounds: surface and surface-raised only. Light 8.49:1 and 7.93:1; Hacker mode 15.35:1 and 11.67:1. AAA in both themes.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1 px card edges, table rules, dividers. Light: Logwood 200, a quiet 1 px edge (1.37:1, a brand value); it never carries meaning alone. Hacker mode: Logwood 700, 3.45:1 on Ink; on Logwood use logwood-400 (6.63:1). Input borders use border-input instead.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: The 2 px rule that closes a section heading.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and active states, always underlined. Grounds: surface and surface-raised. Light 8.76:1 and 8.18:1; Hacker mode 12.47:1 and 9.48:1. AAA in both themes.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover. Hacker mode: white, 21:1 on Ink.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Alert and error text, icons and invalid-field borders, always with the Alert icon and the word. Grounds: surface and surface-raised. Light 7.59:1 and 7.09:1; Hacker mode 7.89:1 and 6.00:1.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: The 6 px bar that opens a section or tops a card, and the progress fill.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: The empty part of a progress bar.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Light: Ink with Paper type. Hacker mode: Mauveine filled blocks and buttons only, with Paper type (8.76:1).

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Type on the primary button.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Highlights, rewards, selection, cursor. Ink type on top.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Type on Weld and Madder fills.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2 px focus outline, 2 px offset. Mauveine on light (8.76:1 on Paper), Weld on dark (14.54:1 on Ink).

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Info text and icon. Ground: status-info-bg. Light 7.93:1; Hacker mode 11.67:1. No border. Word NOTE.

tokens.name: status-info-bg
tokens.usage: Info panel fill.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Success text, icon and 1.5 px border. Grounds: surface and surface-raised. Light 14.20:1 and 13.26:1; Hacker mode 12.47:1 and 9.48:1. Word DONE. Never green.

tokens.name: status-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning fill with a 1.5 px Ink border; text status-warning. Word CHECK THIS.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icon. Ground: status-warning-bg, 14.54:1 in both themes. Word CHECK THIS.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Error text, icon and 2 px border. Grounds: surface and surface-raised. Light 7.59:1 and 7.09:1; Hacker mode 7.89:1 and 6.00:1. Word ERROR.

tokens.name: border-input
tokens.usage: Default input, checkbox and select border: 6.09:1 on Paper, passes the 3:1 control floor.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and selected edges.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind modals, drawers and sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
